post.summary: Gets the specified share public definition.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Share item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

The public definition contains the share's configured assets, recipients, and policies. Runtime state, including the invitation URL, share status, and share version, isn't included.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the share.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Limitations

To retrieve the definition of a share item protected by an encrypted sensitivity label, the caller must have sufficient [usage rights](/fabric/enterprise/powerbi/service-security-sensitivity-label-change-enforcement) to remove the label, as configured in [Microsoft Purview](/purview/purview).
